answer.rationale: The competitor price cut creates acute pressure, but memory_73 explicitly warns that promotional pricing materially reduces 30-day retention despite initial lift—directly contradicting the primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Instead, leverage three high-confidence levers: (1) Activation messaging (memory_91) demonstrated +11% week-one engagement and +1% retention lift with no downside; (2) Simplified onboarding (memory_86, memory_31) reliably improves SMB completion and time-to-value; (3) Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) redirects qualified prospects away from price competition into higher-margin, stickier sales-assisted pipeline. Running activation messaging + onboarding simplification as a standard experiment addresses immediate SMB churn by improving perceived value and engagement velocity, while concurrently strengthening enterprise motion to reduce reliance on price-sensitive segments. This preserves long-term retention health while materially competing on value delivery rather than margin destruction. Referral incentives (memory_57) can follow if retention stabilizes, but activation and simplification are immediate, lower-risk, proven moves.
